summary: Regression-tested the features added after iteration 39. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed. That covers gallery adjust enhance/rotate_left/rotate_right/revert (401 without auth, 422 for a bad action, 404 for an unknown id, rotation dimensions checked, old edited files removed), PATCH tour_id (valid, 404 for an unknown tour, clearing it, persisted in pending), reward-info, the tagged sample photo exposing trip_id=blue-lagoon, and PayPal create-order called ONCE for CB-6N6MRQ26. That call returned an approve_url starting https://www.paypal.com/checkoutnow; the created tx row was deleted and the test is now skipped unless RUN_LIVE_PAYPAL=1. Missing booking returns 404 and an unknown capture order returns 404. Frontend items all pass. Home at 390px: the guest strip is 4800px wide against a 390px viewport and the transform changes over time. The lightbox shows caption/name, next/prev and touch swipe change the photo, Share is visible, and Book links to /tours?book=blue-lagoon for 00569f2ec997 and /tours for the other photo. Right-click and drag are prevented on guest photos. They are not prevented on the QR images on /booking/CB-YGXNNZ35/pass, /track and /payment/success; on that last page the heading is 'You're all set!' and the QR loads. Share-your-photo goes to /gallery#submit with the upload card at top=98px. The reward shows $5. The gallery tour chip filters 35 tiles down to 1 and shows a Book link; the chip toggles off and the All category chip resets. /gallery?tour=blue-lagoon is pre-filtered. The /tours badge links to /gallery?tour=blue-lagoon. The /tours/blue-lagoon strip opens the lightbox. Admin: the edit form tour dropdown has 16 tours plus 'No tour' and saves. Enhance gives the before/after slider (range works) and Undo appears; revert removes the slider. Rotate works. Enhance & approve sets the photo approved and enhanced=true. Approve all shows a confirm dialog and a toast, and skips re-enhancing photos edited by hand. Remove shows a confirm dialog and deletes. Booking modal step 2 offers Stripe, PayPal checkout and Zelle; there is no pay-method-paypal and no PayPal.me text, and the CTA reads 'Continue to PayPal'. /pay/CB-6N6MRQ26 has a 'Pay with PayPal' button. The PayPal return for an unpaid booking shows 'Payment not completed' and a retry link. Two real bugs were found (see action_items).

critical.issue: Facebook auto-post can never find the image file. rel = image_url.lstrip('/').removeprefix('uploads/') leaves 'api/uploads/guest_x.jpg' for every new submission, since the url is always /api/uploads/..., and it returns error 'file_not_found:api/uploads/...'. This was seen on a TEST photo after Enhance & approve. Even with a valid FB token, approve, pin and repost posts would all fail. Fix: rel = image_url.lstrip('/').removeprefix('api/').removeprefix('uploads/').

ui_bugs.issue: Amount shows $0.00 for Cable Beach bookings. These bookings (e.g. CB-6N6MRQ26, total_price 115.5; CB-YGXNNZ35, total_price 152.46) store total_price and have no 'total'. Pay.jsx line 88 uses Number(booking.total || 0) and PaymentSuccess uses money(booking.total), so the Stripe/PayPal cards on /pay/CB-* and 'Total paid' on /payment/success show $0.00. The backend create-order correctly uses total || total_price. Use booking.total ?? booking.total_price on the frontend.
The revert button is labelled 'Undo enhance' even when the only edit was a rotation. Label it 'Undo edits' or 'Restore original'.

design_issues.screen: Booking modal step 2 with PayPal selected
issues: The banner 'Card details are tokenised by Stripe' and the footer 'Powered by Stripe' still show when PayPal or Zelle is selected.

Step 1 shows 'Processing fee (3%)'. Step 2 shows 'Includes 10% VAT & 5% processing' and a $132.17 total. Step 1 has no VAT line in view, so the fee breakdown looks inconsistent to the guest. Please verify.

action_items: Fix facebook.py _post_photo path resolution: strip the 'api/' prefix before 'uploads/'. Right now every gallery FB auto-post, pin post and repost fails with file_not_found.
Pay.jsx and PaymentSuccess: use booking.total ?? booking.total_price so Cable Beach (CB-*) bookings don't show $0.00.

Optional cleanup: BookingFlow.jsx still has dead PayPal.me code (payMethod==='paypal' branch ~line 544, the paypal-instructions step ~1427 and the old Smart-Buttons paypal-checkout-step ~1465). Remove it to avoid confusion.
Optional: rename 'Undo enhance' to 'Undo edits'. Hide the 'Stripe' security copy when PayPal or Zelle is selected.
critical_code_review_comments: BookingFlow.jsx is 1709 lines. Split the payment step into its own component; the dead PayPal.me / Smart Buttons branches remain.

GalleryPanel approveAll approves every pending photo sequentially with no per-item error detail. Acceptable, but if a real guest uploads while the confirm dialog is open, that photo is not included because the list is snapshotted. Fine.
Admin gallery endpoints now correctly require auth (the iter39 critical issue is fixed: 401 without a token).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; $0.00 amount display bug on CB bookings)

seed_data_creation: Created 4 TEST_ gallery submissions (1 via pytest, 3 via the UI flow) and deleted all of them. One PayPal payment_transactions row (order 88N80354LM4850008) was created by the single create-order call and deleted. No gift cards were created, because the submissions had no email.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The live PayPal create-order test is skipped unless RUN_LIVE_PAYPAL=1; delete the created payment_transactions row afterwards. Pending queue was empty of real submissions at test time; check this before clicking admin-gallery-enhance-approve-all. Tour badge links to /gallery?tour=<id>. The gallery tour chip toggles, and the All category chip also resets it. Booking modal reaches step 2 via booking-continue-payment-btn without filling the form, and no booking is created.
rca of the issue: FB: approval stores url '/api/uploads/<file>'. _post_photo strips only a leading '/' and 'uploads/', so it looks up UPLOAD_DIR/'api/uploads/<file>', which doesn't exist. Reproduced: Enhance & approve on a TEST photo set facebook_error='file_not_found:api/uploads/guest_0fe74d69be9b_vd50bfa.jpg'. $0.00: Cable Beach bookings (routes/cable_beach.py:848) write total_price only, and the frontend reads booking.total.
